answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on six datasets across five different text generation tasks: Quora Question Pairs (QQP) for Paraphrase Generation, Wiki-Auto for Text Simplification, Quasar-T for Question Generation, Commonsense Conversation Dataset (CCD) for Dialogue Generation as well as the German-English pairs of IWSLT14 and WMT14 for Machine Translation...

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU and BERTScore as metrics. We also use distinct uni-gram (dist.1) to measure the word diversity within generated sentences...

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation ... annotators decide for the same input sequence, which generated text sequence is better, worse, or of similar quality. ... decide which generated output sequence is better based on whether the one is more consistent with the input question, whether the one has higher grammatical and syntactic quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two generated outputs for the same input and judge which is better, worse, or similar, based on consistency with the input, grammatical quality, and syntactic quality.
